identity.name: Strength
identity.description_easy: How hard you can push, pull, lift, and hit.

credits: checks of its own kind only

balance.stacking_limits: One score. Bonuses on top of it (buffs, items, perks, level) share the +3 check cap in 8.8. The score itself never goes past the attribute ceiling.

getting.prerequisites: None. Every character, NPC, pet, and summon has all eight attributes.
getting.teachers: Not applicable. Growth comes from free stat points, level-ups, rewards, and use.
getting.lost_sealed_taken: Never lost. It can be drained or sealed for a time by curses, wounds, or diseases. Bonuses can be taken away; the score underneath stays.

using.effect: The base step for checks of force: pushing, pulling, lifting, breaking, and hauling. It sets Load. It adds no damage steps by itself; weapon skills and techniques set how hard a hit is (8.7).

noise_visibility_tells.word: it shows in how the body looks and moves

checks.check_type: Plain stat check when no skill matches. Also the base step under a trained skill.

difficulty_tiers.extreme: Lift a cart off a trapped person

untrained.rule: Not applicable. Everyone has this attribute. It is the plain stat used for untrained tasks (Part 2, step 3).

checks.opposed_and_group: Contests use both sides' score plus skills. Helpers add one small bonus, inside the +3 cap.

degrees.bad_failure: You strain a muscle and lose your grip.
degrees.success_at_cost: It moves, but it costs strength, time, or noise.
degrees.great_success: It moves easily and you keep your strength.

checks.failure_costs: A strained muscle, noise, a dropped load, or lost time.
checks.retry: Rest and try again, get help, or use a better tool.
checks.modifiers: Leverage, footing, tools, load, being hurt.

creation_choice.gain: Starting strength comes from race, class, background, and nature.

point_buy.gain: Creation points raise strength above ordinary.
point_buy.grow: Each further step costs more than the last.

class_level_up_capstones.gain: Class level-ups can grant free stat points or a fixed strength gain.
class_level_up_capstones.grow: A class capstone can lift the strength ceiling by one step.

use_with_caps.gain: Hard, repeated use of strength with stakes.
use_with_caps.grow: Use adds a little. The cap is well below what free points can reach.

perk_trees.grow: Each perk in it needs a minimum strength step.

free_stat_points.gain: Free stat points buy strength steps.
free_stat_points.grow: Steps above ordinary cost more points. The ceiling stops the spending.

granted_rewards.gain: Quests, tomes, potions, shrines, and achievements.
granted_rewards.grow: A reward gives a fixed step and never goes above the ceiling.

job_system_cross_equip.gain: A job can give a small fixed gain.
job_system_cross_equip.grow: The gain leaves with the job unless the job system says it carries over.

class_evolution_consolidation.gain: Evolved and merged classes can add a step.
class_evolution_consolidation.grow: The step counts against the ceiling.

cultivation_realms.gain: In cultivation settings, body tempering raises it.

core_stages.gain: A core stage can raise strength by a step.

essence_combinations.gain: A bear or ox essence can add a step.
essence_combinations.grow: Higher grades add more, up to the ceiling.

aspect_flaw_soul_rank.gain: An inborn aspect can lift strength, and its flaw drags another stat.

dao_comprehension.gain: A matching dao adds theme uses of strength.
dao_comprehension.grow: A dao never adds steps beyond the ceiling.

monster_race_evolution.grow: Evolution raises it in set steps.

rarity_grades.gain: Bloodline and grade can lift the ceiling.

modular_sockets_supports.gain: Worn items can add a bonus.
modular_sockets_supports.grow: Item bonuses are bonuses, not score. They share the +3 check cap.

practice_no_screen.gain: With no stat screen, strength shows only in how the character acts.
practice_no_screen.grow: The engine keeps the hidden score. The prose shows the change.

learning_rate_marks.gain: A teacher's mark can speed strength practice.
learning_rate_marks.grow: Faster growth until the cap. A nature can act as this mark.

sponsor_gifts.gain: A sponsor's gift box can hold a stat boon.
sponsor_gifts.grow: Boons are fixed steps within the ceiling.

discovery_from_play.grow: A single great deed can add a step at once.

growth.grade_or_tier: Tier 1 base entry. The score itself runs from very weak to mythic in steps (see the family rules). Which growth style applies in each mode: OPEN:growth_by_mode.

growth.restrictions_taboos: Cannot carry past Load without a penalty.

litrpg.display: An attribute line with its number.
